enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +18: Passive: +18 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Blazing: This weapon is sheathed in fierce flame. A blazing weapon deals an extra 2 to 12 points of fire damage on a successful hit.
Incineration: This weapon stores the power of a raging inferno deep within. Occasionally, this destructive power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive fire damage.
Combustion +108: Passive: +108 Equipment bonus to Fire Spell Power.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
